chapter_seo_title: Dugu Jianmo Names Xiao Chen as True Southern Wilderness Expert
chapter_meta_description: Dugu Jianmo defeats two Yin Capital elites with his iron sword, then points at Xiao Chen as the real first expert of the Southern Wilderness, setting up a showdown with the Four Champions.
og_title: Sword Demon Reveals Xiao Chen as Southern's True Champion
og_description: After crushing Bo Shi and Chen Hangjin, a wounded Dugu Jianmo ignores the healing elixir and points his blade at Xiao Chen, declaring him the strongest from the South.
twitter_title: Dugu Jianmo's Sword Shakes Yin Capital
twitter_description: Dugu Jianmo defeats two noble warriors, then shocks the crowd by naming Xiao Chen as the true first expert of the Southern Wilderness.
